method: The audit covers every entity currently classified as a program in the generated corpus catalog plus named government UAP efforts found in other entity categories, paired-source metadata, and authoritative national records. Included efforts have a source-reviewed start and an explicit end or remain bounded by the catalog review date. Merged aliases, non-program entities, private efforts, and unsupported program claims are recorded in entityReviews and are not rendered as government-program intervals. Evidence status remains visible in every presentation.
